From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Initial tenant setup & keys — Elara Tech

Hi Maria — thanks for the CSV and the clear list. Proposal below for the initial rollout; happy to adjust if you prefer different names/policies.

Planned steps (timeline: ~1 business day for project + admin invites, 2 business days for KMS bindings and service key seeding):

1) Create workspace: project id "elara-prod" in us-west-2 (we recommended region low-latency to your infra)
2) Create roles: Admin, Engineer, Billing-Viewer, API-Service (service account) — see attached role_mapping_matrix.csv with recommended RBAC mappings and least-privilege notes
3) Seed a long-lived service API key scoped to the API-Service role (we typically recommend short TTL + rotation; we can also seed an ephemeral key for testing)
4) Invite 5 users as Workspace Admins/Engineers (based on CSV)
5) Configure KMS binding to your AWS KMS key — we'll need the key ARN and an IAM principal you want to allow to decrypt (we will add Redwood's service principal to the key policy for envelope encryption)
6) Provide audit log location and retention details in the onboarding checklist (attached tenant-access-checklist.md)

Questions / requests for you:
- Confirm region (us-west-2 ok?)
- Confirm preferred key TTL for the admin testing key (default 24h)
- Share KMS key ARN and preferred principal for the policy edit
- Any IP allowlist or CIDR ranges we should add to the admin portal in advance?

I'll action the project creation and invites after you confirm the above. Monica (CS) is cc'd; she will run the short kick-off call and track the implementation tasks. Ben will handle the KMS policy steps and audit log wiring.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: role_mapping_matrix.csv (text/csv), tenant-access-checklist.md (text/markdown)
